senses.gloss:
In the absence of any special role whenever गुण or वृद्धि is enjoined about any expression by using the terms गुण or वृद्धि, it is to be understood to come in the room of the इक् (इ, उ, ऋ, लृ) of that expression.

Terms: गुण-वृद्धि

The affix सन् beginning with a letter of the प्रत्यहार झल् is like कित् after the verbs ending in इक् vowels.

Terms: कित्

The semi-vowels य् व् र् ल् are the substitutes of the corresponding vowels इ उ ऋ and ऌ (long and short), when followed by a vowel.

Terms: संहितायाम्

According to the opinion of शाकल्य , the simple vowels with the exception of अ , when followed by a non-homogenous vowel, retain their original forms; and if the vowel is long, it is shortened.

Terms: संहितायाम्

According to the opinion of गालव a short vowel is substituted in a compound before the second member for the long इक् vowels (ई , ऊ , ॠ) unless it is the long vowel of the feminine affix ई (ङी).

Terms: Some Substitution

The augment (नुम्) न् is added to a Neuter अङ्ग (stem) ending in a simple vowel, except अ , before a case-affix beginning with a vowel.

Terms: नुम् augment
